title: Yi XIANG
text:
Welcome! I am Yi XIANG (向意)
I am an Econ Ph.D. candidate in the Business School at the University of Hong Kong (HKU). I received my master’s degree from the Chinese University of Hong Kong and my bachelor’s degree from Sichuan University.
My research interests encompass Macroeconomics, Economic Development and Growth, Chinese Economy, with a particular focus on technology adoption and trade, agriculture, and migration.
You can reach me at: xiangyi@connect.hku.hk

title: Yi XIANG
text:
Presentations:

2026: Asian and Australasian Society of Labour Economics Conference (PKU, Beijing); ES Australasia Meeting (Adelaide University, Adelaide); Asian SPACE Workshop (SJTU-HKUST, HK); Jobs and Development Conference (HKUST, HK); CES Annual Meeting (SUFE, Chengdu); ES North American Summer Meeting (Emory University, Atlanta); Xi’an Jiaotong University; RCEA International Conference on Economics, Econometrics, and Finance (Universidad Pontificia de Comillas, Madrid); PhD Brownbag (HKU)
2022-2025: PhD Brownbag (×2, HKU); Graduate Seminar (HKU)



Abstract

Farmers may damper from the labor shortage in agricultural production, incentivizing them to transform modernization. This paper documents that population aging increases dramatically over time, especially in the rural areas, whereas the responses of the agricultural mechanization, at the micro level, remain relatively stable in the early stage and start to decrease dramatically, which is inconsistent with the remorseless increase in aggregate. A model is proposed to reconcile this puzzling fact, where heterogeneous labor decides where to work and whether to adopt machinery simultaneously. I show that the more population aging, the agricultural labor productivity reacts nonlinearly and shows an initial plateau and subsequent negative trend turning at age 40, which is partly driven by the nonlinear agricultural mechanization. Further, the rapid development of non-agriculture and the decrease of the overall migration cost due to, for example, the hukou reform, attract more labor sort to the non-agricultural sector, and a higher agricultural mechanization can be accommodated in equilibrium because the selection effect exceeds the labor-mobility barrier effect.




Presentations:

2026: 1st Altitude Conference on Growth and Development (Xizang University, Lsaha); CES Presidential Forum 2026 (UIBE, Beijing); Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST, Wuhan); Asian SPACE Workshop (SJTU-HKUST, HK)

title: 网站部署指南
text:
deploy.sh - 手动部署脚本：一次性构建、提交并推送网站
watch.sh - 自动监视脚本：监视文件变化并自动部署（需要 fswatch）
watch-simple.sh - 简化监视脚本：使用轮询方式，无需额外依赖






cd ~/Documents/GitHub/yixiangecon.github.io
./deploy.sh "提交信息"
如果不提供提交信息，会使用默认信息：“更新网站内容 时间戳”
示例：
./deploy.sh "更新 research.qmd - 添加新的会议报告"



启动监视：
cd ~/Documents/GitHub/yixiangecon.github.io
./watch-simple.sh
然后在另一个终端窗口中编辑您的 .qmd 文件或添加图片到 images/ 目录。保存后，脚本会自动检测变化并执行部署。
停止监视：在运行监视脚本的终端中按 Ctrl+C




如果您想使用 watch.sh（基于事件而非轮询，更高效），需要先安装 fswatch：
brew install fswatch
然后运行：
./watch.sh



自动监视模式会检测以下变化： - 所有 .qmd 文件（包括 index.qmd, research.qmd, personal.qmd 等） - images/ 目录中的任何文件（新增、修改、删除） - _quarto.yml 配置文件 - styles.scss 样式文件




构建：quarto render 将 .qmd 转换为 HTML
提交：自动 git add . 并提交
推送：git push origin main
生效：GitHub Pages 会在 1-3 分钟内自动更新






解决方案：
chmod +x deploy.sh watch.sh watch-simple.sh




确保文件在正确的目录中
检查 _quarto.yml 中的设置
确保文件类型在被监视的列表中





检查网络连接
确认已配置 git 远程仓库：git remote -v
确认有推送权限
查看错误信息并手动运行部署步骤排查







在 ~/.zshrc 或 ~/.bashrc 中添加：
alias site-deploy='cd ~/Documents/GitHub/yixiangecon.github.io && ./deploy.sh'
alias site-watch='cd ~/Documents/GitHub/yixiangecon.github.io && ./watch-simple.sh'
然后使用：
site-deploy "更新内容"
site-watch



nohup ~/Documents/GitHub/yixiangecon.github.io/watch-simple.sh > ~/site-watch.log 2>&1 &
查看日志：
tail -f ~/site-watch.log
停止后台进程：
pkill -f watch-simple.sh



cd ~/Documents/GitHub/yixiangecon.github.io
quarto render
# 检查和预览 docs/ 目录中的 HTML 文件





确保 quarto 命令可用：运行 quarto --version 检查
第一次使用前建议先手动测试一次 ./deploy.sh 确认一切正常
自动监视脚本会持续运行，请确保终端窗口保持打开
如果同时有多个终端修改文件，可能会触发多次提交（脚本有 5 秒防抖）
